# Feature: Dependencies primary topology with cross-cutting overlays

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-04 — issue #382 -->

## Intent

Dependencies default view shows application topology (services/modules/APIs/data/external). Auth/Validation (security) edges are optional overlays — inspectable when enabled, not dominating the default graph (hrkoordinator).

## Preconditions

- Blueprint graph with mixed primary + authenticates/validates edges
- SemanticSystemModel available for overview projection
- Dependencies view open

## Happy Path

- [ ] Default visible edge kinds are primary topology only (imports, calls, api, data, event, external) — auth/validation off
- [ ] Enabling Security overlay adds auth/validation without removing primary kinds
- [ ] Overlay evidence remains inspectable via edge inspector / underlyingEdgeIds
- [ ] Density cap still keeps full underlying evidence ids for visible aggregate edges (drill-down)
- [ ] Reset restores primary default + overlays off

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Graph with mostly auth/validation edges → default shows sparse/primary-only honest graph; security overlay reveals cross-cutting
- [ ] Empty overlays + empty chip selection → empty edge set (honest)
- [ ] Large graph: node density cap ≤ DEPENDENCIES_SEMANTIC_MAX_NODES without dropping evidence backlinks on kept edges

## Regression

- [ ] Overlay UI (dep-overlays) still expands; api/events toggles remain
- [ ] Semantic drill-down to files still works
- [ ] E2E pipeline-honest-throughput overlay interaction still passes

## Assumptions

- Audit appears as matrix/inspector evidence, not a separate dependency edge kind; Security overlay covers auth+validation
- API/Events overlays stay additive focus helpers (union), not exclusive replace filters

## Composition Gate

### Event

User toggles Security overlay / opens Dependencies default → projection filters edge kinds → canvas + inspector.

### Hops

1. `DEFAULT_VISIBLE_DEPENDENCY_KINDS` / chip state → primary kinds
2. `mergeVisibleKindsWithOverlays` unions overlay kinds
3. `projectDependenciesSemanticGraph` filters + aggregates with evidence backlinks
4. Inspector reads `underlyingEdgeIdsByEdgeId`

### Simulations

| Case                 | Expected                             | Observed |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------- |
| Default + auth flood | Primary edges only                   |          |
| Security overlay on  | Auth+validation + primary            |          |
| Density cap          | Evidence ids preserved on kept edges |          |
